plugins.name: pacelab-workout-creator
plugins.description: Design interval workouts in conversation and have them saved straight to your Pacelab Intervals library on iOS or Android — Tabata, AMRAP, EMOM, Circuit, Rounds, For Time. Reads your training history to program against it, schedules sessions to your calendar, and runs shareable challenges with leaderboards. Requires a free Pacelab account.
